title: Amajwi yo ku nkengero z'amazi aratuje
intro: Tekereza umuryango utari uw’umujyi cyangwa umutegetsi, ahubwo witwa amazi atuje aho ubuzima buhurira. Imirongo mike gusa ni yo yibuka uyu muryango, uhora uvugwa mu banze ubuyobozi. Umva uko bavuga mu ibanga.
clues: Turi umuryango witwa muri Korowani, nyamara inkuru yacu yose iracyari ibanga.
Buri gihe tuvugwa hamwe n'abahakanye, nk'abantu ba Ad na Thamud.
Twitwa Abasangirangendo ba Ar-Rass, Iriba ubuzima bwacu bwari bufitanye isano na ryo.
Twahakanye intumwa yatutumweho ifite ubuyobozi busobanutse.
Turi mu banze intumwa zose zoherejwe na Allah.
Twahanganye n'iterabwoba ryashyizwe imbere y'umuntu wese uhakana imbere yacu, kurimbuka kubera kwanga kwacu.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
